name: Thatch
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.398

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven thatch_roof_angled (0.54 m scan of weathered water-reed thatch, stalks down V) 2x2, blended with a shifted copy under an anisotropic mask, slope streaks, graded to the dull gold of the original roofs (weathered grey and fresh straw are vertex-colour blends in the material)
known_weaknesses: 0.54 m scan period is findable close up; butt ends of the courses are geometry, not texture
